891: in spiritual poise and trance, deeply absorbed in the Lord;
ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਮ ॥
he is ever liberated, and all his affairs are fulfilled,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੨॥
in whose heart the Lord's Name dwells. ॥2॥
He has every comfort and bliss, and is free of disease;
he sees all alike, wholly unattached.
ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਡੋਲੈ ਕਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
He neither comes nor goes, nor wavers anywhere,
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
in whose mind the Name dwells. ॥3॥
The Lord of the universe, the Sustainer of the world, merciful to the meek,
meditating on Him through the Guru, worry departs.
The Guru has given Nanak the Name;
ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ; ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੬॥
the service of the saints is the Guru's work. ॥4॥15॥26॥
Sing the praises of the Lord; this is the seed mantra.
Hereafter even the homeless find a home.
Fall at the feet of the perfect Guru,
and awaken from the sleep of many births. ॥1॥
The one who chants the chant of the Lord's Name,
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸੈ; ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in whose heart it dwells by the Guru's grace, crosses the terrifying world-ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao
O mind, meditate on the Name, the eternal treasure;
then the veils of Maya will be torn away.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
Drink the nectar of the Guru's Word;
then your soul will become pure. ॥2॥
Searching, searching, I have reflected and concluded
that without devotion to the Lord there is no release.
ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ; ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
That worship of the Lord is found in the Guru's company,
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਪੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
where mind and body are dyed in the Lord's love. ॥3॥
Give up your cleverness and much cunning;
ਮਨ. ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ; ਜਾਇ. ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
O mind, without the Lord's Name this film of scum does not go.
The one on whom the Lord, Master of the earth, has shown mercy,
Nanak, has taken the Lord's support. ॥4॥16॥27॥
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਲ ॥
In the Guru's company, play the play of the Lord's love,
ਆਗੈ; ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ. ਮੇਲ ॥
and hereafter you will have no meeting with Death.
and all evil thinking is removed. ॥1॥
O pandit, sing the Name and praises of the Lord.
ਕਰਮ ਕਾਂਡ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ. ਨ ਕਾਜੈ; ਕੁਸਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Pride in rituals is of no use, O pandit; so you will go home in peace. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਨਿਧਿ; ਲੀਆ ਲਾਭ ॥
The one who has gained the treasure of the Lord's praise
ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਠਾ; ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
sorrow has fled and peace has come into the home of his heart;
by the Guru's grace the lotus of his heart has blossomed. ॥2॥
The one who has received the gift of the jewel of the Name
Finding the perfect Lord in his mind, contentment has come;
why should he go begging again and again? ॥3॥
Hearing the Lord's praises one becomes pure;
uttering them with the tongue one gains the exalted state and understanding.
The one in whose heart the Guru enshrines them is approved;
Nanak, such people are exalted, O brother. ॥4॥17॥28॥
ਗਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਕਰੀ; ਨ ਆਈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
Grasping her carefully, still she did not come into hand;
loving her dearly, still she did not go along.
Nanak says: when one gave her up,
then she came and fell at his feet. ॥1॥
Listen, O saints, to this pure reflection:
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
without the Lord's Name there is no salvation at all; meeting the perfect Guru one is saved. ॥1॥ Rahao
892: ਜਬ ਉਸ ਕਉ. ਕੋਈ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
When anyone gives honour to Maya,
ਜਬ ਉਸ ਕਉ. ਕੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
When anyone casts her out of his mind,
then she serves him like a handmaid. ॥2॥
She pleases with her face but in the end deceives;
ਇਕਤੁ ਠਉਰ; ਓਹ ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
she never stays in one place.
but the Lord's servants have broken her to pieces. ॥3॥
Whoever begs for her stays hungry;
ਇਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੈ; ਸੁ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥
whoever is absorbed in her gains nothing.
Whoever gives her up and keeps the company of the holy,
Nanak, that fortunate one crosses over. ॥4॥18॥29॥
See the all-pervading Lord in all.
The One God pervades all completely.
Know the priceless jewel to be within your own heart;
Drink the nectar by the grace of the saints.
ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਉ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ. ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It is obtained only by great fortune; without the tongue, how can one know its taste? ॥1॥ Rahao
ਅਠ ਦਸ ਬੇਦ; ਸੁਨੇ ਕਹ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
How can the deaf man hear the eighteen Puranas and the Vedas?
The blind man does not see even millions of lights.
The beast loves grass and is absorbed in it.
ਜਿਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੁਝੈ ॥੨॥
How can the one whom the Lord does not give understanding understand? ॥2॥
He is woven through and through with His devotees.
Those who joyfully sing the praises of their God,
ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੩॥੧੯॥੩੦॥
Nanak, Death does not come near them. ॥3॥19॥30॥
The one to whom the Guru gave the Name has been made pure;
ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ; ਨਿਰਾਸ ਇਹ ਬਿਤੁ ॥
with the Lord's wealth as his capital, he is detached from this worldly wealth.
The Guru cut away his bonds and joined him to the Lord's service,
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ; ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
and he worships the Lord and sings His praises. ॥1॥
ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ; ਅਪਨੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Lord's servants, on whom their Divine Guru has bestowed grace, sing His praises with relish. ॥1॥ Rahao
The good destiny of past births has come to fruition;
asleep for many births, one awakens.
In the Guru's company aversion to others has gone,
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤੋ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
and mind and body are dyed in the Lord's love. ॥2॥
The merciful Protector has protected him,
ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੇਵਾ; ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
without regard to any service or labour of his.
God has shown mercy and kindness,
and pulled him out as he drowned in sorrow. ॥3॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
Hearing His praise again and again, yearning welled up in his mind,
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
and at all hours he sings the Lord's praises.
Singing and singing them, he has attained the supreme state;
Nanak, by the Guru's grace he has fixed his attention on the Lord. ॥4॥20॥31॥
For a shell he gives up the jewel;
he strives for what will leave him.
He gathers what is of little worth;
bewitched by Maya, he walks crooked with pride. ॥1॥
O wretched one, have you no shame,
ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਹਰਿ. ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that you do not remember in your mind the Lord, the perfect Transcendent One, the ocean of peace? ॥1॥ Rahao
To him nectar is bitter and poison sweet;
I have seen with my own eyes the way of the faithless.
He delights in falsehood, deceit and pride;
893: hearing the Name, it is as if a scorpion has stung him. ॥2॥
ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਬਹਿ; ਨ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
and never praises the Lord in his mind or with his mouth.
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਨ ਕਰੈ. ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
the fool does not love Him. ॥3॥
O Lord, You are the true King above all kings,
needing no one, the perfect Sovereign.
Beings are drowned in attachment, clinging to Maya, with the knot of doubt tied within.
Nanak, only by Your mercy can one cross over. ॥4॥21॥32॥
May I chant the Lord's Name day and night,
and find a place in His court hereafter.
There is ever bliss and no sorrow,
and the disease of ego never afflicts. ॥1॥
O saints who know God, seek the Lord.
ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਾ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ, ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remembering the Lord, O mortal, you will be wonderstruck in wonder, and attain the supreme state. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ. ਤਾਰਿ ॥
without the Name no one can carry you across.
All other efforts do not go with you;
the terrifying world-ocean is crossed only in God's love. ॥2॥
Washing the body, filth is not removed;
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ; ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
The one who takes the medicine of the Lord's Name,
ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੋਗੁ; ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
Be merciful, O merciful Supreme Lord;
ਮਨ ਤੇ; ਕਬਹੁ. ਨ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ॥
O Lord of the world, may You never be forgotten from my mind.
May I become the dust of the feet of Your servants;
O perfect Divine Guru, I have come to your refuge.
Without you there is no other.
You are all-powerful, the perfect Supreme Lord.
Only the one with full grace meditates on You. ॥1॥
O God, Your Name is the ship to carry beings across.
ਏਕਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ. ਮਨ ਮੇਰੈ; ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ. ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My mind has grasped Your refuge alone; without You I have no other place. ॥1॥ Rahao
Chanting and chanting Your Name, I live,
and hereafter I shall find a place in Your court.
Pain and darkness depart from the mind
and evil thinking is destroyed, of the one absorbed in the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
Love for the Lord's lotus feet has welled up;
this is the pure way of the perfect Guru.
Fear has fled, and the Fearless Lord dwells in the mind
of the one whose tongue ever chants the life-giving Name. ॥3॥
The nooses of millions of births are cut,
and the profit of the true wealth is earned.
The inexhaustible storehouses never run short;
Nanak, the devotees look beautiful at the Lord's door. ॥4॥23॥34॥
His Name is the jewels and gems,
it is the treasure of peace, poise and compassion,
and it has been entrusted to the Lord's devotees. ॥1॥
Such is the treasure of my Lord:
ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਿ ਕਛੁ ਤੋਟਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
eating and spending, it never runs short; the Lord has no end or limit. ॥1॥ Rahao
His praise is a priceless diamond,
through which comes the bliss of the deep Ocean of virtues;
the unceasing Word of praise is the capital;
and He has placed the key in the saints' hands. ॥2॥
894: In the heart where it dwells is the cave of trance free of Maya's thoughts, and there the attention is seated;
there dwells the perfect Lord alone.
God holds converse with His devotee;
ਤਹ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਸੋਗ; ਨ ਜਨਮ. ਨ ਮਰਤ ॥੩॥
there is no joy or sorrow, no birth or death. ॥3॥
The one to whom the Lord in His mercy has given it,
he has found the Lord's wealth in the holy company.
ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਵਰਤਣਿ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੫॥
may the Lord be my daily provision, and the Lord my capital. ॥4॥24॥35॥
The Vedas do not know His greatness.
Brahmas do not know His secret.
The incarnations do not know His limit.
The Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord, is infinite. ॥1॥
He alone knows His own state;
others speak of Him only from hearsay. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Shivas do not know His secret;
the gods have grown weary searching.
The goddesses do not know His mystery.
Above all is the unseen Supreme Lord. ॥2॥
In His own joy the Creator plays His play;
He Himself separates and Himself unites.
Some He leaves wandering, some He joins to devotion.
His own creation He Himself gives understanding. ॥3॥
Hear the true testimony of the saints:
they speak what they see with their eyes.
ਨਹੀ ਲੇਪੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਪਿ ॥
Neither virtue nor sin stains Him;
I have done no good deed deliberately;
my attention and mind do not dwell in spiritual wisdom;
I know nothing of chanting, austerity, good conduct or duty;
I do not know what rituals are like. ॥1॥
O my Master, my Beloved, my God,
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਭੂਲਹ ਚੂਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
there is no other but You; though we err and stray, O God, we are Yours. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਰਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ; ਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
I have no wealth, no wisdom, no miraculous powers, no enlightenment;
ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੇ ਗਾਵ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
I dwell in the village of vice and disease.
O my God, the One Creator,
ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥
the support of Your Name alone is in my mind. ॥2॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਉ; ਮਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Hearing and hearing it I live; this is the comfort of my mind:
Your Name, O God, is the destroyer of sins.
You are beyond count, the Giver of life;
only the one to whom You give understanding has known You. ॥3॥
Whoever You have created places hope in You;
all worship You, O God, treasure of virtues.
Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to You;
my Master is infinite and merciful. ॥4॥26॥37॥
The merciful Lord is the Protector;
dwelling on Him for an instant, millions of births are cut away.
meeting the Guru and taking his teaching, God is met. ॥1॥
My God is the Giver to all beings;
ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
my God, the perfect Transcendent Master, pervades every heart. ॥1॥ Rahao
O mind, the one who has grasped His support
Meditating in the heart on the Lord of supreme bliss,
The Lord's refuge is the ship to carry across;
the Lord's feet are the very form of life.
895: He is the support of the saints' breath of life,
the highest of the high, infinite. ॥3॥
ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
Take up that sublime understanding by which the Lord is remembered,
which He Himself in mercy gives.
The Lord's Name is peace, poise and bliss;
Nanak, whoever has chanted the Name has done so by meeting the Guru. ॥4॥27॥38॥
and serve in the spirit of a servant.
The one who erases all self-conceit
obtains the fruits of his heart's desire. ॥1॥
Be attentive to your Guru's teaching,
ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and your hopes and desires will be fulfilled; from the Guru you will obtain all treasures. ॥1॥ Rahao
the True Guru is the Immaculate Lord Himself.
ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Do not think of him as merely human.
Lean on the support of the Guru, the form of the Lord,
and give up all other hopes.
Ask for the treasure of the Lord's Name,
and you will receive honour in His court. ॥3॥
Chant the mantra of the Guru's Word;
this is the essence of true devotion.
Those on whom the True Guru becomes merciful,
Nanak, those servants are in bliss. ॥4॥28॥39॥
and give up your own pride.
Day and night ever sing His praises;
this alone is the perfect aim of life. ॥1॥
Meditate on the Lord, the saint, and enjoy bliss.
ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪਿ ਮੰਤੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Give up cleverness and much cunning, and chant the Guru's pure mantra. ॥1॥ Rahao
Keep hope in the One alone within you,
and chant the pure Name of the Lord.
and you will cross the terrifying world-ocean. ॥2॥
The Lord is the Giver, able to give all;
He has no end or limit.
In whose home are all treasures,
He alone is the Protector in the end. ॥3॥
the pure Name of the Lord.
ਜੋ ਜਪੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Whoever chants it attains the exalted state;
Nanak, it is obtained by His grace. ॥4॥29॥40॥
Make fruitful this precious human body,
and you will not go to His court having lost the game.
You will have honour here and hereafter,
and at the last moment it will set you free. ॥1॥
Sing the praises of the Lord.
ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਦੋਵੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ; ਅਚਰਜ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meditate on the wondrous Lord, and both this world and the next will be pleasant. ॥1॥ Rahao
Standing and sitting, chant the Lord's Name,
This is the most exalted deed,
the most sublime duty among all duties.
Remembering the Lord, you are saved,
and the burden of many births is lifted. ॥3॥
and Death's noose will be cut.
Nanak, one merges in peace and poise. ॥4॥30॥41॥
896: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ. ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Acknowledge as His whatever belongs to Him;
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਤੂ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
All belong to the One to whom you belong;
worshipping Him there is ever peace. ॥1॥
O estranged one, why do you wander in doubt?
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ. ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮਿ, ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without the Name nothing is of any use; crying "mine, mine", many have departed in deep regret. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ; ਸੋਈ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
Whatever He does, accept it as right;
without accepting, you will mingle with the dust.
The one to whom His will seems sweet,
by the Guru's grace, in the mind of that rare one He dwells. ॥2॥
He Himself is carefree and beyond the senses;
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
O mind, meditate on Him at all hours.
When He comes into your mind, sorrows are destroyed,
and your face is radiant here and hereafter. ॥3॥
Who and how many have been saved singing His praises
ਗਨਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਕੀਮ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
cannot be counted; its worth cannot be told.
Even sinking iron crosses over in the holy company;
Nanak, only the one so destined does so. ॥4॥31॥42॥
Meditate on the Lord in your mind;
the perfect Guru has given this mantra.
All fear and dread are erased,
Fruitful is the service of the Divine Lord.
ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
His worth cannot be told at all; He is the Truest of the true, unseen and unfathomable. ॥1॥ Rahao
He Himself is the Doer and the Cause of doing;
O mind, ever meditate on Him.
and you will obtain truth, poise and peace, O friend. ॥2॥
in an instant He creates and destroys.
There is no other but Him;
He alone is His servant's protector. ॥3॥
In Your mercy, hear my prayer:
grant Your servant the sight of You.
May Nanak ever chant the chant of Him
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੪੩॥
whose glory is highest of all. ॥4॥32॥43॥
Trust in people is in vain.
O Master, O God, Yours is my support.
for the one who meets the carefree Master, the treasure of virtues. ॥1॥
O my mind, meditate on the One Name alone.
ਕਾਰਜੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your affairs will be accomplished; sing the Lord's praises, O my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao
You alone are the Creator of the world;
I stay in the refuge of Your lotus feet, O Lord.
The one who has meditated on Him alone in mind and body
has been shown the blissful form of the Lord. ॥2॥
by whom all beings were made.
Remembering the Lord, all treasures are obtained;
in the end, He alone is the Protector. ॥3॥
Become the dust of the feet of all;
Meditate on the Name day and night;
O Cause of causes, Generous Lord,
You Yourself are the Master of all, great and beyond count. ॥1॥
897: I bow to the One Lord, the Master of the world,
ਖਾਲਕੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Creator who pervades all places. ॥1॥ Rahao
O Lord of the world, Life of the world, Master of Maya,
Destroyer of fear, worthy to be worshipped in the heart,
Master of the senses, Sustainer of the world, Lord of the universe,
Giver of liberation, You pervade everywhere. ॥2॥
You alone are the merciful Master;
You are the deliverer of pirs, prophets and sheikhs.
He is the Master of hearts and dispenses true justice;
He is beyond what the Quran and the Semitic scriptures describe. ॥3॥
The merciful Lord is Narayan and Narhar;
Ram pervades all, the support of every heart;
His play cannot be described at all. ॥4॥
O Creator, show mercy and kindness;
O Maker, You Yourself give devotion and worship.
Nanak says: the one whose doubts the Guru has removed
sees that Allah and the Supreme Lord are one. ॥5॥34॥45॥
The sins of millions of births are destroyed;
chanting the Lord's Name, no suffering touches one.
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ; ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ ॥
The one in whose mind the Guru's lotus feet dwell,
ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ; ਤਨ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਨਸੇ ॥੧॥
all great vices flee from his body. ॥1॥
O mortal, sing the praises of the Lord of the world.
ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one who sings the true, indescribable praise of the perfect Lord, his light merges in the Light. ॥1॥ Rahao
All his thirst and hunger for Maya is destroyed,
who by the Guru's grace has meditated on the Imperishable Lord.
Night and day he serves God;
this is the sign of having met the Lord. ॥2॥
Their entanglements end on whom God becomes merciful;
beholding the Guru's sight they are in rapture.
The good deeds of their past have come to fruition,
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ; ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
and with their tongues they ever sing the Lord's praises. ॥3॥
The Lord's saints are ever approved;
on the saints' foreheads shines the mark of approval.
ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ. ਪਾਏ ਜੇ ਕੋਇ ॥
Whoever obtains the dust of the feet of such a servant,
ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੪੬॥
Be a sacrifice for the Guru's sight;
enshrine in the heart meditation on his lotus feet.
Apply the dust of the saints' feet to your forehead,
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
and the filth of evil thinking of many births departs. ॥1॥
Meeting the Guru, pride is erased,
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and the Supreme Lord is seen everywhere; O perfect Lord, be merciful and let me meet him. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ; ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
To chant the Lord's Name is the praise of the Guru;
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ; ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
to ever sing His praises is devotion to the Guru;
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ; ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
to know the Lord near is meditation on the Guru;
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
accept the Guru's Word as true. ॥2॥
Through the Guru's word, pleasure and pain seem alike,
and thirst and hunger for Maya never afflict.
Through the Guru's Word the mind is content and sated;
meditating on the Lord of the universe, all one's faults are covered. ॥3॥
The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Guru is the Lord of the universe;
the Guru is the Giver, merciful and forgiving.
ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
The one whose mind is attached to the Guru's feet,
Nanak, that servant's destiny is perfect. ॥4॥36॥47॥
898: On whose support do you roam the world?
O foolish fool, who is your companion?
ਰਾਮੁ ਸੰਗੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਗਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
The Lord is your companion, yet you do not know His state;
ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੇ; ਸੇ ਮੀਤ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥੧॥
the five robbers you take to be your friends. ॥1॥
ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
Serve that home through which you will be saved, O friend.
ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਰਵੀਅਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Sing the praises of the Lord of the universe day and night; join your mind in love to the holy company. ॥1॥ Rahao
Life passes in pride and strife;
one is never sated with the taste of Maya.
Wandering and wandering, one has suffered great pain;
the treacherous ocean of Maya cannot be crossed. ॥2॥
ਕਾਮਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
One does deeds that are of no use;
one sows and oneself eats the fruit.
There is no other to save one;
one is saved only when He shows mercy. ॥3॥
O God, Your Name purifies sinners;
grant this gift to Your servant.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
Be merciful, O God, and exalt my state;
Nanak has grasped Your refuge, O God. ॥4॥37॥48॥
He has found peace in this world;
he does not have to face the Judge of Dharma;
he is honoured in the Lord's court,
and does not dwell in the womb again. ॥1॥
I have come to know the worth of the saint's friendship.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ; ਪੂਰਬਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In his mercy he gave me the Lord's Name; by destiny from the past I found it. ॥1॥ Rahao
When my mind became attached to the Guru's feet,
blessed, blessed and fortunate was that union.
ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
The dust of the saint's feet touched my forehead,
and all my sins and sorrows were removed. ॥2॥
When one truly serves the holy one,
then the mind becomes pure, O mortal.
Fruitful is beholding the sight of the Lord's servant;
ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੩॥
God's Name dwells in every heart. ॥3॥
All strife and suffering are erased,
ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
and one merges into the One from whom one came.
The incomparable Lord of the universe becomes manifest,
By the Lord's grace the tiger, the mind, herds the cow, the senses;
the shell becomes worth hundreds of thousands;
the elephant of pride cherishes the goat of humility,
when one's God looks with His glance of grace. ॥1॥
O treasure of mercy, my Beloved God,
ਬਰਨਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕਉ; ਬਹੁ ਗੁਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I cannot describe Your many virtues. ॥1॥ Rahao
The cat does not eat the meat it sees;
the great butcher throws away his knife;
when the Creator God comes to dwell in the heart,
the net holding the fish is torn. ॥2॥
Dry wood turns green and bright;
on high ground beautiful lotuses blossom;
the Divine True Guru has quenched the fire of craving,
and joined His servant to His service. ॥3॥
He is ever the helper of His saints;
Nanak, they stay in the refuge of His lotus feet. ॥4॥39॥50॥
899: God has killed the five tigers within me;
He has driven off the ten she-wolves of the senses;
the whirlpool of the three qualities has ceased to spin;
in the holy company the fears of the round of births have ended. ॥1॥
Remembering and remembering the Lord of the universe, I live.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਦਾਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In His mercy He has saved His servant; the True Lord is ever and ever forgiving. ॥1॥ Rahao
Sins as high as Mount Sumer burn up like straw
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਪੂਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੈਰ ॥
when one repeats the Name and worships God's feet.
The Lord, the form of bliss, becomes manifest everywhere
to the one who joins his attention to loving devotion, the jewel of peace. ॥2॥
He crosses the ocean as if it were a calf's hoofprint,
ਖੇਦੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਨਹ ਫੁਨਿ ਰੋਜ ॥
and suffers no pain or worry again.
The ocean is contained in a little pitcher;
for the Creator this is no wonder. ॥3॥
When one lets go of Him, one falls to the netherworld;
when He pulls one out, His glance brings rapture.
Sin and virtue are not in our control;
Nanak, those He favours sing His praises with relish. ॥4॥40॥51॥
ਨਾ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
Neither the body is yours, nor the mind,
yet you are caught in attachment to Maya and deceit.
As the lamb frolics with the sheep,
suddenly the net of death falls and its wheel crushes it. ॥1॥
O mind, seek the refuge of the Lord's lotus feet.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Chant the Lord's Name, your companion and helper; turning to the Guru, you will obtain the true wealth. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮਦਿ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਝੂਰੇ ॥
in lust, anger and the intoxication of Maya one ever frets.
One commits sins for the sake of one's own life,
but not a bit goes with the heedless one. ॥2॥
He practises deceit and knows countless tricks;
ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉ; ਖਾਕੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਨੈ ॥
for every shell he throws dust on his own head.
ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ; ਤਿਸੈ. ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
He does not remember at all the One who gave him all;
his false greed and its pain never leave him. ॥3॥
When the Supreme Lord becomes merciful,
this mind becomes the dust of the holy.
With his lotus hands the Guru attaches him to his hem,
and Nanak, he merges in the Truest of the true. ॥4॥41॥52॥
In the refuge of the Sovereign Lord,
ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ. ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
singing the praises of the Lord of the universe, they have become fearless; in the holy company sorrow departs. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਰਾਮੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
The one in whose mind the Lord dwells
does not even see the treacherous world-ocean.
He sets all his affairs right,
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਸਨ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥
ever chanting the Lord's Name with his tongue. ॥1॥
ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ; ਹਾਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਰੈ ॥
The one on whose forehead the Guru places his hand,
why should that servant feel anxiety?
His fear of birth and death is ended;
he is a sacrifice to the perfect Guru. ॥2॥
Meeting the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, one is in rapture;
ਸੋ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ; ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
only the one on whom He is merciful obtains that sight.
The one on whom the Supreme Lord shows mercy
crosses the world-ocean in the holy company. ॥3॥
Drink the nectar, O beloved saints,
and your faces will be radiant in the True Court.
Give up all vices and enjoy bliss;
Nanak, meditating on the Lord you will cross over. ॥4॥42॥53॥
900: Fire keeps away from the firewood in which it dwells;
ਮਾਟੀ ਕਉ; ਜਲੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
the waters of the ocean keep away from the land on all sides;
the feet are above and the sky below, as a tree with roots above;
in a pitcher the Ocean Lord has revealed Himself. ॥1॥
So all-powerful is the dear Lord Himself.
ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜੀਅ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੈ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He is not forgotten for an instant from the minds of His devotees; O mind, meditate on Him at all hours. ॥1॥ Rahao
First comes the butter, and afterwards the milk;
He turns filth into milk white as pure soap;
the fearless soul goes about afraid of fear;
the unreal Maya robs the real soul. ॥2॥
The body's Master is hidden, and the body alone is seen;
creating all, the Lord of the world plays His plays;
the cheat, Maya, ever cheats the guileless soul,
ਬਿਨੁ ਵਖਰ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
and without the merchandise of the Name, it clings again and again to Maya. ॥3॥
Gather in the assembly of saints and expound
the Simritis, Shastras, Vedas and Puranas;
ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੪॥
Whatever pleases Him comes to pass.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਆਨ ਬੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Stay ever in the Lord's refuge; there is no other but God. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਲਖਿਮੀ ਦੀਸੈ; ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
Son, wife and wealth are seen, but none of these goes along.
ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਖਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥
Eating the drug of sensual pleasures one strays, and at last leaves Maya and mansion and departs. ॥1॥
ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ; ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
Slandering again and again he is greatly ruined, and by his deeds falls into the womb.
ਪੁਰਬ ਕਮਾਣੇ. ਛੋਡਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਜਮਦੂਤਿ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਿਓ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੨॥
Past deeds do not let him go, and the terrible messenger of Death seizes him. ॥2॥
ਬੋਲੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅਵਰਾ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹਇਆ ॥
He speaks falsehood and does otherwise; his craving is never quenched, and he ever laments for more.
ਅਸਾਧ ਰੋਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ. ਸੰਤ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਹਾ ਖਇਆ ॥੩॥
By slandering the saints an incurable disease arises, and his body perishes in that great wasting. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸਾਜੇ; ਆਪੇ ਕੀਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਇਆ ॥
The One who honoured the saints also fashioned them, and Himself made them victorious.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਇਆ ॥੪॥੪੪॥੫੫॥
Nanak, in His mercy and kindness the Supreme Lord keeps His servants hugged close. ॥4॥44॥55॥
Such is the perfect Divine Guru, my helper,
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ; ਬਿਰਥਾ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whose teaching of remembrance never goes in vain. ॥1॥ Rahao
Beholding his sight one is in rapture;
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ; ਕਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
the dust of his feet cuts Death's net.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸੇ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੇ ॥
When his lotus feet dwell in the mind,
he sets right all the affairs of mind and body. ॥1॥
The one on whose forehead he places his hand
finds my God, the Master of the masterless.
The Guru is the saviour of sinners, the treasure of mercy;
be ever and ever a sacrifice to him. ॥2॥
The one to whom he gives the gift of the pure mantra
is abandoned by vices, and his pride is destroyed.
Meditate on the One Lord in the Guru's company;
in the love of the Name, sins are destroyed. ॥3॥
The Guru, the Transcendent Lord, dwells in all;
the treasure of virtues pervades every heart.
O God, grant me Your sight; I place my hope in it.
Nanak ever offers this true prayer. ॥4॥45॥56॥
